card.name: Linking words before a patient condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'with', 'without' or 'and' right after a patient group (patients, children, adults, rhinitis), just before a disease or condition is named. Also fires on a few other spots where a word is about to be completed, such as 'Treat' or the start of a rare name.

modes.label: with/without after a group
modes.description: 'with' or 'without' follows a patient group and introduces a condition.
modes.example: The center focuses on health and wellness for children and adults<< with>> disabilities.

modes.label: Treat after 'intended to'
modes.description: The verb 'Treat' appears in the MAOI switching heading, before the disorder is named.
modes.example: Switching a Patient To or From a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (MAOI) Intended to<< Treat>> Psychiatric Disorders: At least 1

modes.label: Start of a rare name
modes.description: A first letter of an unusual disease name or a joining 'and' in a list of people.
